errors.text_span: 从左到右，柱状图高度逐渐减小
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bar height increases from position 1 to position 2, and again from position 2 to position 3, before it starts to decrease. It does not gradually decrease across the entire chart from left to right.
The bars are not sorted in descending order of value. They are arranged sequentially by their x-axis category, from 1 to 11. The tallest bar is at position 3, not at the beginning of the chart.
